title: Edits to any seed farm plan (1-7, incl. farm 1 North Meadow) are silently reverted on every reload while the UI shows 'Saved'
evidence: store.ts:86-88 — `for (const key of Object.keys(fresh.plans)) { merged.plans[Number(key)] = fresh.plans[Number(key)]!; }` re-seeds plans for ALL seed farm ids on every boot (comment at :77-80 calls this intentional demo policy). But usePlanEditor.ts:524-536 autosaves those edits, localApi.ts:227-231 writes them to localStorage, and PlotDesigner.tsx:90-93 shows a 'Saved <time>' badge. seed.ts:709-717 ships seed plans for every farm id 1-7, so the primary route #/farms/1/map always loses user edits on reload.
expected: A plan the UI reports as Saved restores after reload (or the UI clearly marks seed-farm plans as non-persistent demo content).
actual: Reload discards all plan edits on farms 1-7 with zero indication; the 'Saved 3:04 PM' badge is a false persistence promise.
fixHint: Only re-seed a seed farm's plan when the stored plan is unmodified vs seed (compare updatedAt or a seeded hash), or show a 'Demo — resets on reload' badge instead of 'Saved' on seed farms.

title: Failed autosave renders a red (destructive) badge labeled 'Ready' — no 'error' label branch exists
evidence: usePlanEditor.ts:532-535 sets saveState='error' + toast on save failure; PlotDesigner.tsx:91 label chain is `saving ? 'Saving…' : saved ? 'Saved …' : dirty ? 'Unsaved' : 'Ready'` — 'error' falls into the final else 'Ready', while :90 sets variant='destructive' for it.
expected: A failed save shows an explicit error state (e.g. 'Not saved') and some retry affordance.
actual: User sees a red badge that says 'Ready'; saveState stays 'error' with no retry until the next edit reschedules the autosave.
fixHint: Add an `saveState === 'error' ? 'Not saved'` branch to the badge label.

title: Stale autosave response overwrites planRef without a version bump — lost-update race under remote backend
evidence: usePlanEditor.ts:527-528 — `const saved = await apiFetch.savePlan(nextPlan); planRef.current = clonePlan(saved);`. With restApi (restApi.ts:133-138, real fetch latency), strokes made while the save is in flight mutate planRef.current in place; when the stale response resolves, planRef is replaced with the pre-stroke state WITHOUT setPlanVersion — canvas keeps showing the strokes (no redraw) while state has silently reverted, and the next autosave persists the reverted plan. With default localApi (localApi.ts:227-231, synchronous body) the await resolves in a microtask before any pointer event can interleave, so the window is benign by construction.
expected: Saving a snapshot must never clobber plan state newer than that snapshot (e.g. compare a monotonically increasing edit counter before assigning planRef).
actual: Under VITE_API_BASE_URL, edits made during an in-flight save are silently dropped from state.
fixHint: Tag each scheduled save with an edit sequence number; ignore/resync responses older than the latest planVersion.

title: 'Farm not found.' / 'Plan not found.' plain-text dead ends with no navigation
evidence:
PlotDesigner.tsx:68-70 — `if (!farm) return
Farm not found.
; ... if (!currentPlan) return
Plan not found.
;` — early return skips the header, back arrow (:76-78) and every panel. Reachable by typing a bad id or deleting a farm in another tab.
expected: A not-found state offering a link back to the dashboard.
actual: Bare sentence; user must hand-edit the URL.
fixHint: Render a 'Back to dashboard' button inside the not-found branches.

title: Line tool's Erase payload silently uses the Erase tool's hidden layer selection
evidence: applyLineCells maps rectMode==='erase' to mode 'erase' (usePlanEditor.ts:671-674), and mutateCell's erase branch reads eraseLayer (:578-591). The Plants/Ground layer Select only renders when tool==='erase' (DesignerToolbar.tsx:99-109), so with Line+Erase active the erased layer is whatever was last picked in the Erase tool — possibly 'ground' — with no visible indicator.
expected: Line+Erase erases the layer the user can see/choose, or defaults to plants.
actual: Hidden eraseLayer state decides; switching Erase layer earlier changes Line behavior invisibly.
fixHint: Show the layer Select for line+erase too, or force eraseLayer='plants' when entering line erase mode.
